items.source:
GoogleGenAiEmbeddingConnectionDetails represents the details of a connection to the
embedding service using the new Google Gen AI SDK. It provides methods to create and
configure the GenAI Client instance.
items.translation: GoogleGenAiEmbeddingConnectionDetails 表示使用新的 Google Gen AI SDK 连接到嵌入服务的详细信息。它提供了创建和配置 GenAI Client 实例的方法。

items.source: Christian Tzolov, Mark Pollack, Ilayaperumal Gopinathan, Dan Dobrin
